notes: Editable counter-strategy knowledge base. Each rule fires when an opponent metric crosses a threshold. `expectedPoints` is the point swing you gain if the counter is executed, `requires` gates the rule on your own capability, and `confidence` reflects how well the metric predicts the behaviour. Thresholds are defaults for a V5-era game — tune them per season.

rules.title: Contest autonomous
rules.action: Send your auton into their starting quarter instead of your own safe route. Denying a weak auton converts their weakest 15 seconds into a 1v0 phase.
rules.trigger: If your auton lands, press their start tile immediately at driver start

rules.title: Deny their endgame
rules.action: Their score is carried by a big endgame. Occupy the endgame structure in the last 20 seconds and force a late, lower-value climb.
rules.trigger: At 0:25, commit one robot to the endgame zone, not to scoring

rules.title: Pressure a low floor
rules.action: A low floor means the bad version of this team is very bad. Play contact-heavy early: every disrupted cycle compounds, because they have no recovery pattern.
rules.trigger: From 1:30, bump their primary scorer on every route to the scoring zone

rules.title: Bait them into penalties
rules.action: They are already penalty-prone. Force contested possessions near protected zones so marginal calls go against them, and never retaliate.
rules.trigger: Never match their contact; disengage and re-enter from the far side

rules.title: Beat them on cycle consistency
rules.action: Their score swings wildly. Do not chase their peak — protect your own floor, take the safe cycle, and let their variance lose the match for them.
rules.trigger: If you are ahead by 10 at 0:30, switch to safe cycles and endgame only

rules.title: Starve the shared objects
rules.action: A large share of their points comes from a small number of field objects. Pre-load and deny that object class before they can start their routine.
rules.trigger: First 30s: clear their target object class, not the nearest one

rules.title: Exploit untested auton paths
rules.action: Low programming-skills output usually means their auton was never run under pressure. Expect a failure or a slow route; plan your auton to finish in the space they vacate.
rules.trigger: If their auton visibly fails, take their abandoned zone immediately

rules.title: Neutralise the carry, then beat the support
rules.action: One robot produces most of their ceiling. Do not try to out-score the carry — suppress the support robot and win the 1v1 on the second-best scorer.
rules.trigger: Assign your second driver to their support robot for the whole match

rules.title: Protect an early lead
rules.action: Strong teams convert leads. If you get ahead, slow the game down: safe cycles, endgame first, no hero plays.
rules.trigger: Ahead at 0:45: endgame first, then score with whatever time remains

rules.title: Press a slow starter
rules.action: Low driver-control output means their first cycle is slow. Take the centre immediately and hold it — the early 15 points are the cheapest points in the match.
rules.trigger: First 20s: take and hold the primary scoring zone
